reviews.title: I like the app ❤️❤️
reviews.text: At least I can view some of the service without having to pay for everything not like others app (luna 🤮🤮)
reviews.reply: Dear customer, hello! We appreciate your positive feedback! It's great to hear that you like the available features of Nebula. If you have any questions or need assistance, please feel free to contact us at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com. Thank you for your support! Best wishes, Nebula team 🔮

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.reply: Your review made our day 💜 So lovely to know Nebula brought a smile your way. Warmly, Nebula 🔮

reviews.title: Not a good experience
reviews.text: Disappointed with the quality I had with the advisor I spoke to.
reviews.reply:
Nebula welcomes you, Asia,

We greatly appreciate your time to leave us a review.

We truly regret that you were disappointed with the quality of the reading you received. Thank you for giving us the chance to improve and serve you better.

We would like to resolve this situation and understand what exactly didn’t meet your expectations, so we can avoid similar issues in the future. However, it's important to remember that a successful reading often comes from approaching the experience with an open mind, as the best sessions are built on mutual respect and understanding between the client and the advisor.

To ensure we resolve this matter promptly, we invite you to contact our customer support team at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com. Our agents are ready to assist you with care and efficiency.

Take care and stay inspired, Nebula team 🔮
